Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: This is a non-review research paper that does not involve any LULC future prediction. The study analyzes historical land cover changes (2000–2015) using existing datasets, but does not simulate or project future land use/land cover under any scenarios. It fails core inclusion criteria: no future scenarios are implemented, and the primary focus is on assessing human impacts on ecosystem indicators (VFC, NPP) within China’s nature reserves—not on LULC prediction. Additionally, while the study is national in scope, it excludes aquatic and coastal reserves and focuses only on 299 of 428 national nature reserves, but more critically, it lacks any predictive modeling component. The exclusion criterion “No LULC prediction component” applies directly.)
